notes: *put it* supplies an object the Hebrew does not write — וַיִּתֵּן carries no suffix — so *it* is its own `added` unit under rule 44 and is not folded into the verb.
Both altar chains write two *the*s; rule 29's arthrous case assigns the inner one to the rectum's article and the outer, supplied, to the construct noun.
The assimilated article of בַּדָּם takes the written *the* under rule 12, while אֶל before the base is rendered *at* under rule 11.
